explanation: The class encapsulates login page elements and interactions following POM pattern.

class LoginPage:
    def __init__(self, driver):
        self.driver = driver
        self.username_input = (By.ID, 'username')
        self.password_input = (By.ID, 'password')
        self.login_button = (By.ID, 'login-btn')
    def login(self, user, pwd):
        self.driver.find_element(*self.username_input).send_keys(user)
        self.driver.find_element(*self.password_input).send_keys(pwd)
        self.driver.find_element(*self.login_button).click()
print('LoginPage defined')
